**Lectura de datos**
```{r}
if(!require("readxl")){
install.packages("readxl")
library("readxl")
} else {
library("readxl")
}
datos <- read_excel("Movilidad.xlsx")
head(datos)

```

**Cargar Paquetes**
```{r}

if(!require("BSDA")){
install.packages("BSDA")
library("BSDA")
} else {
library("BSDA")
}
```

**Pregunta 1**
```{r}
x <- datos$Tiempo[datos$Residencia == "Rural"]
mean(x)

length(x)
z.test(x, sigma.x = sd(x),conf.level = 0.96)$conf.int
```


**Pregunta 2**
```{r}
y <- length(which(datos$Transporte == "Motocicleta"))
n <- nrow(datos)
prop.test(y, n, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int

```


**Pregunta 3**
```{r}

morning <- length(which(datos$Periodo == "Manana"))

prop.test(morning, n, p = 0.6, alternative = "greater", conf.level = 0.93)
```
